2609.17109.title: Shared-Prefix KV Reuse Across Standard LoRA Adapters: Quality and Serving Tradeoffs
2609.17109.paper_summary: A common small-model deployment runs one shared backbone with several LoRA specialists that answer over the same context. Serving them naively re-prefills that shared context once per specialist. We study a narrow, practical question: for already-trained standard LoRA adapters -- not adapters retrained for cache compatibility -- how much task quality is preserved if the backbone's prefill KV cache is computed once and reused across specialists, and what does that buy in serving cost? On a Qwen3-1.7B backbone with two adapters (extractive QA on HotpotQA, arithmetic reasoning on GSM8K), we sweep the boundary at which the specialist takes over from the reused base cache and measure paired quality differences and serving cost. Full-prefix reuse had the lowest prefill cost and a small quality difference on held-out GSM8K (Delta = -4.6 EM at a 160-token budget; -3.0 at 320 tokens; -0.8 under a second training seed -- all favoring native, only the first excluding zero, and the magnitude not consistent). Partial recomputation provided no demonstrated advantage. Neither quality equivalence nor a general boundary-selection rule is established. We also report a closed-form ridge KV translator that did not beat direct reuse, and specialist-dependence contrasts whose intervals all include zero. The measured serving benefit is warm-cache time-to-first-token, which grows with context (~16x at 8K); two-branch peak memory was only 12% lower and, on inspection, the prefix was never physically shared across branches -- this implementation reuses KV values but copies their storage, so shared-cache memory savings are not achieved.
2609.17109.paper_summary_zh: 一個常見的小型模型部署運行一個共享的骨幹，並有幾個 LoRA 專家在相同的上下文中進行回答。天真地為它們提供服務會在每個專家中重新填充一次共享上下文。我們研究一個狹窄且實際的問題：對於已訓練的標準 LoRA 適配器——而不是為了緩存兼容性而重新訓練的適配器——如果骨幹的預填 KV 緩存只計算一次並在專家之間重用，任務質量會保留多少，並且這樣做在服務成本上帶來了什麼好處？在一個 Qwen3-1.7B 的骨幹上，使用兩個適配器（在 HotpotQA 上的抽取式 QA，和在 GSM8K 上的算術推理），我們掃描了專家接管重用基礎緩存的邊界，並測量了配對質量差異和服務成本。完全前綴重用的預填成本最低，在保留的 GSM8K 上質量差異很小（在 160-token 預算下 Delta = -4.6 EM；在 320 tokens 下為 -3.0；在第二個訓練種子下為 -0.8——所有結果均有利於原生，只有第一個排除零，且幅度不一致）。部分重新計算沒有顯示出任何優勢。質量等價性或一般邊界選擇規則均未確立。我們還報告了一個封閉形式的 ridge KV 轉換器，未能超越直接重用，以及專家依賴性的對比，其區間均包含零。測量到的服務好處是溫緩存的首次令牌時間，隨著上下文增長而增長（在 8K 時約 16 倍）；兩分支的峰值記憶體僅低 12%，並且經檢查，前綴從未在分支之間實際共享——這個實現重用 KV 值但複製其存儲，因此未實現共享緩存的記憶體節省。
2609.17109.author: Dushyant Rajput et.al.
